MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expressions.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expressions.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expressions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.

2. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

3. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

4. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

6. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

5. D — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

7. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

8. (4 marks)

9. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
